reversibilitySpecies.user-reversible-in-app: Undo is genuinely available to the user inside the product. The undo > confirm rule and the treatment column below apply as written.
reversibilitySpecies.ops-reversible: Reversal exists only as an operational/support process (refunds, chargebacks, account restores). Review-then-commit is the domain norm; NO_UNDO is not a defect here. Payments live in this species.

notes.species: The treatment column assumes user-reversible-in-app. For ops-reversible actions, replace undo affordances with review-then-commit (confirm with named consequence); safety-check.py downgrades NO_UNDO to an advisory note when a card declares ops_reversible: true.
notes.sparsity: The matrix is deliberately sparse — it enumerates the load-bearing rows, and the `default` rule below covers the rest; an uncovered coordinate is resolved, never a silent gap.

default: Uncovered (blast × reversibility) coordinates take the nearest higher-friction neighbor's treatment: step reversibility toward irreversible, then blast upward, until an enumerated row matches — never resolve downward to lighter friction. E.g. high × instant → high × days → confirm-plus-audit; medium × session → medium × minutes → recall-window.
